gates.name: workloads/game-service: npm run test (vitest, against docker compose's PostgreSQL)
gates.detail: With 'docker compose up -d' run first (game-service-postgres-1, healthy) per the workload README: Test Files 4 failed | 20 passed | 1 skipped (25). Tests 8 failed | 182 passed | 1 skipped (191). Every one of the 8 failures is 'Error: Test timed out in 5000ms' on tests that spawn real subprocesses or run real timers against the local Postgres container: contention-two-instances.test.ts S7.1/S7.2/S7.3-S7.4 (spawnInstances / cross-instance round trip / two-instance contention), compose.test.ts S4.4/S4.7/S4.8 (readiness flip, sweep reclaim, sweep never touching profile rows), contention-one-instance.test.ts S6.1/S6.6, and fresh-clone-migration.test.ts S11.3. None is a functional assertion failure (no 'expected X, got Y') - all are the vitest default 5000ms timeout elapsing on this local machine's Docker/subprocess latency. Before Postgres was started, all 48 durable-store tests failed with '{"code":"Unreachable"}' from migrateToHead, which is the expected DidNotRun-shaped failure for an unprovisioned store, not a code defect; that state is superseded by this run.
